Package com.example.space.prompts

Class ModifyBodyPrompt

java.lang.Object
com.example.space.prompts.ModifyBodyPrompt
public class ModifyBodyPrompt extends Object
A dialog prompt for modifying the properties of an existing celestial body. Allows editing of mass, radius, position, and velocity.
